facts: MediCruz Medical Clinic, Tampa. The homepage says the clinic is on W Dr Martin Luther King Jr Blvd. Our listing address is 2309 W Dr Martin Luther King Jr Blvd Ste 2, Tampa, FL 33607. Phone (813) 348-3946. Website https://medicruztampa.com/.

Hours Monday through Friday 08:30 AM to 05:30 PM. Saturday and Sunday closed. The site says insurance is accepted and also offers a Basic Plan at $50/month with unlimited primary care visits, same-day or next-day appointments, direct provider access, and bilingual English and Spanish care.

Services named: primary care, allergy testing, preventive care, wellness exams, EKG, lab testing, GLP-1, women's health, minor illness, men's health, hormone consultations, skin care and aesthetic treatments, wart removal, walk-in clinic, immunizations, IV therapy, pre-employment physicals, annual physicals, chronic care, and weight management. Lead clinician named: APRN Orlando Cruz, described as having over 30 years of experience.
Stored database hours match the weekday clocks and the weekend closure.

Nearby from our coordinates: St. Joseph's Hospital 0.46 miles at 3001 W Dr Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, slug saint-josephs-hospital. Blind Tiger at St. Joseph's Women's Hospital 0.52 miles at 3030 W Dr Martin Luther King Jr Blvd, slug blind-tiger-5.

faq.a: The homepage says insurance is accepted. It also lists a $50/month basic plan for people without insurance or with a high deductible. Ask which one applies to your visit.
The site lists Saturday and Sunday as closed. Weekdays are 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM.
Our listing says Ste 2 at 2309 W Dr Martin Luther King Jr Blvd. The homepage names the boulevard and the phone, (813) 348-3946. Confirm the suite when you call.
